rules: star-map exclusion != cause of becoming an enemy
Tomori and Present Yui do not have different official IAU 88 sets merely because of their Current era bands
Character hook != ownership / zodiac / Star Beast / fate
外典星座 is CANDIDATE and must not replace 朔夜座

categories.label: Current 88
categories.meaning: Modern IAU constellation framework. Stable reference layer for present-day comparison.

categories.label: Obsolete / historical
categories.meaning: Historically proposed or used constellations not retained as modern official constellations.

categories.label: Renamed / absorbed
categories.meaning: Historical identity or figure later represented within another accepted constellation framework.

categories.label: Name fossil
categories.meaning: A historical constellation name survives in modern vocabulary even though the constellation itself is obsolete.

categories.label: Restructured
categories.meaning: A historical constellation identity was later divided or reorganized into multiple modern constellation identities.

categories.label: Archival only
categories.meaning: Useful for old atlas / archive / mystery authoring; not a modern Character identity by default.

entries.name: Quadrans Muralis
entries.storyUse: S clue: modern Quadrantids preserves the historical name trace.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: Do not claim Tomori lived under a different official postwar constellation list.

entries.name: Argo Navis
entries.storyUse: A clue for one historical identity becoming multiple modern recognized regions.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: Do not force Character identity, twin identity, or Robot personhood conclusions from the split.

entries.name: Machina Electrica
entries.storyUse: Shows that people projected contemporary technology into the sky.

entries.name: Officina Typographica
entries.storyUse: Record medium / printing / archive clue; useful for information surviving while classifications change.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: A changed classification does not imply written records are false.

entries.name: Robur Carolinum
entries.storyUse: Authority and patronage can be visible in historical sky-map naming.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: Political naming does not make all official constellations arbitrary or corrupt.

entries.name: Antinous
entries.storyUse: A person-name can disappear as a standalone figure while the stars remain.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: Do not reduce Antinous to generic tragic aesthetics.

entries.name: Felis
entries.storyUse: Low-stakes old-atlas clue that teaches the audience historical sky figures can differ from the modern 88.
entries.forbiddenShortcut: Cat Character != Felis owner; obsolete != evil.

groupGlossary.definition: Season 1の8人の正式な主要敵集団名。外典星座などの星座史Candidateで置き換えない。
各時代の大事件の中心人物・人物群を後世の記録側から括る名称。固定組織・固定人数・善悪集団ではない。
Character側の星獣Authority。obsolete constellation researchから自動で一対一割当しない。
長所・願いと恐怖・焦りが一つの答えへ極端化した状態。obsolete constellationであることを原因にしない。
歴史的には使われたが現代88星座には保持されていない星座・図像の研究分類。善悪属性ではない。
旧星座・星図外モチーフを世界内Archive等で括る候補名。朔夜座の代替正式名称ではなく、Canon未確定。
